description: macOS binary distribution policy for the Instantee CLI package.

rpath.notes: CLI is currently linked only to Apple system frameworks. INSTALL_RPATH reserves @loader_path/../lib for future private dylibs; no third-party .dylib is shipped in V1.

signing.notes: Local/CI binary distributions are ad-hoc signed (codesign -s -). Developer ID + notarization is a later distribution channel, not required for the install-smoke acceptance of a relocatable prefix.
